research.research_name: Counterfactual Text Generation via Geometric Style Control
research.summary: Models stylistic attributes as directional structures in language-model representation space, enabling targeted intervention without relying only on prompt-level control.
research.contribution: Develops contrastive, identity-preserving, and semantic objectives that move representations toward target style anchors while limiting semantic drift.
research.result: Current evaluation combines attribute classifiers, embedding similarity, BERTScore, LLM-based judges, and geometric analysis.

research.research_name: Adversarial Detection with Minimum Description Length
research.summary: Treats adversarial transformation as a complex causal mechanism and measures how perturbations change the information required to describe a sentence.
research.contribution: Builds masked-language-model workflows for perturbation preparation, fill-mask generation, and description-length comparison.
research.result: Published in Entropy 26(5), 354; the method detects adversarial manipulation without requiring the original text at inference time.

research.research_name: Robust Hate Speech Detection via Mitigating Spurious Correlations
research.summary: Uses a causal graph to explain how lexical cues create spurious shortcuts and make classifiers vulnerable to word- and character-level attacks.
research.contribution: Introduces a causal-strength regularizer that trades a small amount of clean-set utility for substantially stronger adversarial robustness.
research.result: CEBERT achieved 85.9% accuracy on word-replaced data and 86.0% on misspelled data, compared with the strongest reported baselines at 70.3% and 73.7%.
